footer.line: Made of pixels. Fond of paper.

home.headline: A little paper for your very expensive rectangle.
home.intro: Paper adds a paper texture to your Mac. Pick one you like, adjust it, and get on with whatever you opened the computer to do.
home.sample_title: Leave a little room for nothing.
home.sample_text: An empty page. A cup going cold. That one idea that turns up when you stop trying so hard. There are worse ways to spend an afternoon.
home.preview_note: A web preview using real Deckle texture tiles. Your display and settings will look a little different.
home.features_title: A small app. A few nice touches.

features.title: Find your kind of paper.
features.body: 26 textures, from quiet Soft Wove to something with a bit more character. Save your favorites and the looks you keep coming back to.

features.title: Let the day do its thing.
features.body: Set a schedule, follow sunrise and sunset, or switch looks with light and dark mode. Paper can pause on battery or in Low Power Mode.

features.title: Know when to disappear.
features.body: Exclude an app or a display. Snooze for a while. Pause for a presentation. Sometimes the right amount of paper is none.

home.workflow_body: Give each display its own intensity. Assign a look to a particular app, bring in a Deckle recipe, or use Shortcuts to put Paper into your routine. It lives in the menu bar and stays out of your clicks.
home.workflow_note: A reading strip, a warm Desk Lamp, and saved desk setups are there when you want them, too.
home.faq_title: Before you put paper on your computer.

faqs.a: Paper is free and open source, and it always will be. Download it, use it, tinker with it. That’s the whole arrangement.

faqs.q: Will it work on my Mac?
faqs.a: Paper is built for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later. It does not support Intel Macs, Windows, or Linux. The developer docs keep the testing limits explicit.

faqs.q: Does it read or record my screen?
faqs.a: No. Paper draws a texture over the screen. It does not capture what’s underneath, and it needs no Screen Recording, Accessibility, or Input Monitoring permission.

faqs.q: What about screenshots and screen sharing?
faqs.a: Use Pause for presentation before you capture or share, then check your preview. Different capture tools handle overlays differently; Paper doesn’t promise to hide from them.

Your settings and recipes stay local. City searches use Apple’s geocoding service, update checks use GitHub, and a diagnostic report is only sent when you review it and choose Send. The privacy page has the details.

home.credits_title: The paper part owes a lot to Deckle.
home.credits_body: A big thank-you to Deckle and its contributors. Paper uses Deckle’s texture renderer and paper catalog, and adapts its recipe model for imports. Their open-source work made this possible.
home.support_body: If you’d like to support Dust Wave, thank you. Donations are optional. Everyone gets the same free app.
home.bottom_title: All right. Let’s put some paper on it.

support.options_title: A little support goes a long way.

one_time.title: Once is lovely.
one_time.body: Choose an amount that suits you.
